title: Random Forests--Random Features
summary: Leo Breiman's University of California, Berkeley Statistics technical report 'Random Forests--Random Features' is dated September 1, 1999. The report describes random forests as combinations of tree predictors in which each tree depends on an independently sampled random vector, and discusses random feature selection for tree splitting.
significance: A documented research-publication milestone for random forests, represented strictly as the dated Berkeley technical-report record rather than as a universal invention or release date.
